title: sluice.yml
description: The configuration of sluice, the release tool for a Maven project split over the git submodules of one umbrella. The modules, their pins and their tag order come from the poms; this file holds only what the poms do not say.

target.description: Where every module publishes, unless its own entry says otherwise. Default: none.

branch.description: The release branch of every module.

tag.description: A tag's name, {version} standing for the version.

ignore.description: Globs of files whose change alone does not make a module changed.

modules.description: Per-module settings, keyed by the submodule's path.

text-pins.description: Versions written as text in a file, moved with the module they pin.

after-release.description: Per module, pom properties set in its back-to-snapshot commit; {tag} and {version} stand for the release.

changelog.description: The Keep a Changelog feature: true, or a map naming how each module's notes are read.

extractor.description: The command that prints a module's notes for a version, run in the module's folder.

pins.description: Whether a release only for its upstreams gets its notes from the pins it moves.

gates.description: Project gates, each a command run before any tag.

steps.description: Project steps, each a command at a point of the release.

asset-pins.description: Files that pin a module's released asset by hash, set once its release is out.

github-releases.description: Whether each tag of a module on GitHub gets a release page, its changelog's notes.

owed.description: What a run does, unless --with-dependents or --no-dependents says, with a dependent that pins a module it releases: release it at its next patch, or refuse the run until it is asked for.

maven.description: The Maven version JitPack's builds run, the ceiling of each module's pinned plugins: 3.9.9.

kind.description: maven: released by its pom. tag-only: tagged, no pom. ignored: not released, pinned or read.

place.description: Where it tags beside the order its pins give.

in.description: The file, from the umbrella's root.

pins.description: The module whose version it holds.

match.description: A regular expression whose first group is the version.

to.description: The module that depends on it.

modules.description: The modules it runs in; every released one when absent.

skip-exit.description: The exit code that means the gate could not run: SKIPPED.

modules.description: The modules it runs in; every released one when absent.

module.description: The module whose release attaches the asset.

file.description: The JSON file whose version, url and sha256 the asset sets.

bumps.description: JSON files whose version the same commit raises by a patch.

oneOf.description: A shell line: sh -c on Linux, cmd /c on Windows.

command.description: One line for both systems, or a map giving each its own.
